mentions.name: Loop
mentions.description: A mobile-first companion workspace for coding agents that treats agent results as the primary unit of work to navigate, replacing chat-based mobile UIs. It runs on the user's own computer with no account, server, or app store, pairing via a Cloudflare quick-tunnel QR code. It wraps existing agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Pi, OpenCode, Antigravity, Muse Code, Grok Build, or any ACP agent, keeping each agent's own context, tools, sign-in, and billing, and also supports local models through Pi or OpenCode.
mentions.problem: Mobile UIs for coding agents are all chat-based, which is a poor mobile UX when you're doing multiple things at once, such as holding a newborn while talking to agents one-handed.
mentions.audience: A coding agent users who want to work from a phone, especially those multitasking while doing hands-on tasks
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on Loop: a mobile-first companion workspace for coding harnesses.
